entries.name: Mamono
entries.content:
Mamono are the creation of life through Mamono Mana, a magical substance that corrupts life and morphs it into a beautiful and voluptuous humanoid that lives off of spirit essence which can only be found in human men and is stored in their semen which all mamono desperately craze.

Many mamono seek out a human husband so that they can feed off on the semen and create new breeds of mamono through breeding. Some mamono won't go after humans who are already claimed by another mamono, but others generally don't care and attack on sight. As such, they are enemies of the Holy Order of the  Chief Goddess, who forbids humans from coexisting with them. Despite this, there are some humans who have broken those commandments and willing give themselves up to the mamono.

Mamono always have a human-like shape  except for centaurs and other mamono, but in general, the upper body and head is of a human woman who is incredibly beautiful and captivating, and from the waist down, it can be anything, like tentacles for the scylla,  or bird legs for harpies and gandharvas.

entries.name: Lescatie
entries.content:
{{char}} lives in Lescatie. It was once served as Holy Order kingdom led by an incompetent ruler who oppressed the people. Frequently referred to as the "Religious Kingdom of Lescatie" or the "Theocracy of Lescatie", the nation was ruled by a hereditary monarchy. However, the king had little real power, "The state of Lescatie was dominated by the power of the Church, namely the high-ranking representatives of the Order sent here from the theocratic country, where its headquarters were located-and the Senate, composed of local priests and the most noble aristocrats", and Priest Noscrim is noted to be the de facto real ruler of Lescatie. Once amongst the most powerful of the Order states, Lescatie was particularly noted for the high-quality human heroes it produced. By providing other nations with its military might to help prevent monster invasions as well as wars between human countries, Lescatie received products or money in return. However, they refused to provide said protection to countries or remote villages that could not afford to pay. The Lescatian upper classes, allied with the aristocracy of their neighbors, could simply rob the common people under their protection to nothing, and some of the knights who were supposed to protect the people, but had evil intentions in their hearts, often made them suffer.

However, after things changed after Druella, the fourth daughter of the Mamono Lord and her forces aided in undermining the human's will, creating civil unrest that allowed the kingdom to lose its grip on the people. Within a few weeks, Druella succeeded in corrupting many of the heroes against their former nation; after her takeover succeeded, Lescatie was transformed into a Mamono Realm. An Order counterattack (accompanied by Amanomiya Koyoi) failed miserably, and today, Lescatie is a "radically obscene" land of monster girls, lust and depravity. Although nominally the realm is ruled by the "Seven Princesses", including "Queen Roper" Francisca who inherited the throne from the previous king, de facto power rests with Druella herself.

Mamono realm Lescatie still provide military aid to other nations, such as by sending dark knights to them in response to their request for assistance in return of alliances between countries and help in the development of its lagging industries, such as transferring technology or sending engineers from other countries to Lescatie to exchange experiences. Mamono realm Lescatie is also the base of Kuroferuru's Sabbath branch, a loli cult that embraces pedophilia.

After Lescatie's fall to darkness, Wesple and Luce sent out a battalion to ward off the mamono from fully taking over Tolba by, creating a stalemate at Gertra that has lasted 432 years.
